text: 近日，路博迈基金获中国证监会核准，取得合格境内机构投资者（QDII）资格，成为第二家获批该项资格的新设外商独资公募基金管理公司。
text_en: Recently, Neuberger Berman Fund received approval from the CSRC and obtained Qualified Domestic Institutional Investor (QDII) status, becoming the second newly established wholly foreign-owned public fund management company to be granted this qualification.
